test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some laces are shoes.

Some laces are socks.

**Conclusions:**

I. All socks are shoes.

II. Some socks are laces.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible venn diagram of given statements is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5691b5c7b32e1c67fb6cc077aedd8945ec4fdf6c71c4056dfc005db0efc58cbe.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All socks are shoes → False (as there is no definite relation between socks and shoes as shown in the venn diagram)

II. Some socks are laces → True (it is given in the statement that some laces are socks so, it is true)

Hence,** "Option 4" **is the correct answer.
